biz_relation_id.title: Biz Relation Id
biz_relation_id.description: The id of the BizRelation of the new owner. This is used when transferring ownership between app users. All other fields must be omitted when providing this field.

biz_user_email.title: Biz User Email
biz_user_email.description: The email of the BizUser that will receive the ownership transfer request. This is used when transferring ownership to a biz user. The `message` field is optional when providing this field, but `biz_relation_id` must be omitted. The transfer request is available for 1 days.

message.title: Message
message.description: Message to be included in the email sent to the new owner.
